sources.title: Freeport approves $4.5 billion Bagdad copper mine expansion
evidence: announced today that its Board of Directors approved a $4.5 billion expansion and modernization program for its Bagdad
The project is designed to more than double the mine’s production capacity
representing incremental production of approximately 225 million pounds annually.
The expansion includes new concentrator facilities providing approximately 115,000 metric tons per day
Construction is expected to take approximately 3.5 years, with initial production targeted for mid-2030.

sources.title: Gulf oil flows dip in October from post-Iran war high, data shows
evidence: Gulf oil exports dipped in October from September's levels, which were the highest since the Iran war started
Faced with intensifying attacks on shipping around the Strait of Hormuz, which reached a record in October,
Flows of crude, condensate and refined products, excluding LPG, averaged 17.1 million barrels per day in October
Data from another company, Kpler, also showed a drop in shipments, with crude and condensate flows down about 1 million bpd
Iraq, Oman and Kuwait all exported less, the figures showed.
